DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ワンちゃんとお散歩ですね。園路の案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Taking your dog for a walk? Would you like to see the park path guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めて来ました。この広場を通って一周しようと思うんですが、向こうで音楽が鳴っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬との散歩予定を伝え経路上の音楽に気付いて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This is our first visit. I was thinking of making a loop through this square, but I hear music over there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe your planned dog walk and ask about music on the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は広場で催しをしています。しばらく音が出る予定です。ワンちゃんは大きな音が苦手ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an event in the square today. Sound is expected for a while. Is your dog sensitive to loud noises?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 雷の音でも隠れてしまうので、近づくのはやめたいです。広場を通らずに歩ける道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 犬の音への反応を説明し催しを避ける道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even thunder makes the dog hide, so I do not want to go near it. Please tell me a path that avoids the square.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your dog's reaction to sounds and request a route avoiding the event. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物の裏を通る園路でしたら、広場から離れています。ただ、途中に細い橋があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The path behind the building is away from the square. There is a narrow bridge along the way, though.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋では人とすれ違うのが心配です。リードを短く持ちますが、混んでいたら手前で引き返してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋ですれ違う懸念を示して混雑時の引返しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I worry about passing people on the bridge. I will keep the leash short, but may we turn back before it if it is crowded?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express concern about passing on the bridge and ask about turning back when crowded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、橋を渡らなくても戻れます。入口までの道を塞がない所で向きを変えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can return without crossing. Please turn around somewhere that does not block the path to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。犬が落ち着かなければ短い散歩で切り上げます。催しを避けた道も同じ入口に戻れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 犬の様子で散歩を切り上げる意向と同じ入口への帰着を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If the dog does not settle, I will finish with a short walk. The route avoiding the event also returns to the same entrance, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm ending the walk depending on your dog's condition and returning to the same entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、建物の裏を往復してこちらへ戻れます。途中の催し会場への分かれ道は曲がらずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can go behind the building and return here. Continue without turning at the branch toward the event venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、裏の道だけ歩きます。橋が混んでいたり犬が怖がったりしたら、無理に先へ行かず戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 裏道に限定し橋の混雑や犬の反応で引き返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we will only walk the back path. If the bridge is crowded or the dog is frightened, we will return rather than push on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to use only the back path and turn back depending on bridge congestion and your dog's reaction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが裏の園路です。リードを付けたまま、周りの方にも気を配ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the back park path. Keep the leash on and be considerate of others as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えの経路をお探しですか。どの案内をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a transfer route? Which guide are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家へ行きます。途中で乗り換えると聞いて地図を開いたんですが、いったん駅の出口へ行けばいいんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人宅への乗換えで駅外の地図を見て出口へ向かうべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to a friend's house. I heard I need to transfer, so I opened a map. Should I first go to the station exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are viewing an outdoor map for a transfer to a friend's house and ask whether to head to the exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この乗り換えでしたら、出口へ出ずに構内の連絡通路を通れます。地図は駅の外の道を表示していますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this transfer you can use the connecting passage inside without going out. Your map shows the streets outside the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外に出るつもりでした。切符は目的地まで買っているので、改札を出ずに次のホームへ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地までの切符があり改札を出ず次のホームへ行きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was planning to go outside. My ticket is already to my destination, so I want to reach the next platform without leaving the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a ticket to your destination and want the next platform without exiting the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、案内図の青い線が連絡通路です。階段とエレベーター、どちらがよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then the blue line on the station map is the connecting passage. Would you prefer stairs or an elevator?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: エレベーターを使います。重い荷物がありますが、青い線をたどると途中で階段になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物のためエレベーターを希望し図の経路に階段があると指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the elevator. I have heavy luggage, but following the blue line leads to stairs along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an elevator because of luggage and point out stairs on the mapped route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: エレベーターはこの分かれ道を左です。少し遠回りですが、階段を使わず同じホームへ出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The elevator is left at this fork. It is a slight detour, but reaches the same platform without stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左の道へ回ります。降りた先で反対方向の列車に乗らないよう、何を見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迂回路を選び逆方向へ乗らない表示確認を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go left. After going down, what should I check to avoid boarding a train in the opposite direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the detour and ask which signs to check to avoid the opposite direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ホームの行き先表示で、友人のメッセージにある駅を確かめてください。駅名が見つからなければ係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the platform destination signs for the station in your friend's message. If you cannot find its name, ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出口の地図ではなく構内の案内で移動します。左のエレベーターへ回り、ホームで友人が書いた駅名を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 構内の案内と左のエレベーターを使い行き先を確かめると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow the station's internal signs rather than the exit map. I will go to the elevator on the left and check the station my friend wrote on the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to use internal signs and the left elevator, then check the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡通路の入口はこちらです。荷物に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The connecting passage entrance is here. Please take care with your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談ですね。ご一緒の方も同席されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here for a consultation. Will the person with you join you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の上司です。ここまで案内してくれましたが、相談は私一人で話したいです。別に話せるか確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上司は道案内の同行者で本人一人で相談できるか取り次ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: He is my supervisor at work. He showed me the way here, but I want to discuss this alone. Could you check whether I can speak separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your supervisor accompanied you to show the way and ask staff to check about consulting alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。お一人で説明する際に、言語の支援はご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Would you like language assistance when explaining on your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。簡単な日本語なら話せますが、給料について聞きたいので、上司を通訳にするのは困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給与の相談で上司を通訳にできず別の言語支援を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I can speak simple Japanese, but I want to ask about my pay, so having my supervisor interpret would be a problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request other language assistance because a pay consultation prevents using your supervisor as interpreter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上司の方とは別の言語支援を希望されるのですね。手配できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You want language assistance separate from your supervisor. I will check whether it can be arranged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日難しければ別の日でも構いません。上司には、私は一人で相談したいとだけ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支援が難しければ別日も可能で上司には同席不要だけ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Another day is fine if it is difficult today. I only want to tell my supervisor that I wish to consult alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that another day is possible if support is unavailable and you will tell your supervisor only that you want no accompaniment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談の内容をこちらから上司の方へ伝える予定はありません。ご本人への連絡方法を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We do not plan to tell your supervisor the content of your consultation. How should we contact you personally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の携帯へお願いします。会社の番号には掛けないでください。昼休みには静かな所で話せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡は会社でなく本人携帯と指定し昼休みの静かな場所で応答可能と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please call my mobile. Do not call the company number. I can speak somewhere quiet during lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify your own mobile rather than the company and explain availability somewhere quiet at lunch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を記録します。上司の方はどちらでお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record your wishes. Where will your supervisor wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口で待ってもらいます。私は担当の方の案内を待ちますので、一人で話したいことと言語支援の希望を引き継いでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上司には入口で待ってもらい本人のみ相談と言語支援を担当へ引き継ぐよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask him to wait at the entrance. I will wait for the staff's guidance, so please pass on my wish to speak alone and have language assistance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask that your supervisor wait at the entrance and that staff pass on your request for an individual consultation and language support. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。同席と支援について確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the accompaniment and assistance arrangements before guiding you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票のどこでお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the medical questionnaire is troubling you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 膝の痛みの欄で「いつも」と「時々」があります。歩き始めだけ痛くて、しばらくすると減るんですが、どちらに丸を付けるか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頻度の二択に当てはまらない歩き始めの症状を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: For knee pain, there are choices of always and sometimes. It only hurts when I start walking, then decreases after a while, so I am unsure which to circle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain symptoms when starting to walk that do not fit the two frequency choices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当てはまらない場合は、横の空欄にご自身の言葉で書いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: If neither fits, you may write in your own words in the blank space beside them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら「歩き始めに痛い」と書きます。毎日あるので、時々に丸を付けると、何日かに一回と思われそうなんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 毎日と動作時の違いが伝わる自由記述を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will write that it hurts when I start walking. It happens daily, so circling sometimes may suggest once every few days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose free text that distinguishes daily occurrence from occurrence during an action. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気になる違いを、診察でもお伝えください。痛み始めた時期は書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also explain that distinction during the examination. Can you write when the pain began?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週からです。昨日は座っているときも痛かったので、それを別に書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発症時期と昨日の座位時の変化を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Last week. Yesterday it hurt even while sitting, so I want to write that separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the onset time and yesterday's change while sitting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、変化したことも記入してください。「昨日」の日付が分かると、経過が伝わりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please record the change too. Giving the date of yesterday helps convey the progression.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付を入れます。説明すると長くなりそうなので、書いたものを見ながら話してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日付を示し記入した内容を見ながら説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put the date. The explanation may be long, so may I speak while looking at what I wrote?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the date and request to explain while consulting the written details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。必要でしたら、看護師にもこの記入内容を見てもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. If needed, a nurse can also look at what you wrote.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、看護師の方にもお願いします。毎日の歩き始めの痛みと、昨日座っていても痛かったことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日々の動作時症状と新しい変化を分け看護師にも説明すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please ask the nurse too. I will distinguish the daily pain when starting to walk from yesterday's pain even while sitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to explain daily movement-related symptoms and the new change separately to the nurse too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入できましたらお知らせください。看護師へ、症状の説明を希望されていることを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us know when you finish writing. I will tell the nurse that you want to explain your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メッセージについてのご相談ですね。どんな内容でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a message. What did it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料金を今日中に払わないと困ることになると書いてあって、怖くなってリンクを開いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払催促の恐怖でリンクを開いたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It said something bad would happen unless I paid the fee today, and I was frightened and opened the link.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report opening a link out of fear from a payment demand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開いた先で、情報を入力したり支払いをしたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you enter information or make a payment on the page you opened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前やカード番号は入れていません。住所の欄が出たので閉じましたが、開いただけでも何か起きたのか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報未入力とページを閉じたことを説明し開いた影響への不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not enter my name or card number. An address field appeared, so I closed it, but worry whether merely opening it caused anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain entering no information and closing the page, and express concern about the effect of opening it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで、その点も含めて相談内容を伺います。表示された文面や送信元は、まだ残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hear your concerns, including that point. Do you still have the text shown and the sender information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージは残っています。画面を見せます。怖かったので送り主を消そうと思いましたが、今は消していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元メッセージを残しており削除していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have the message. I will show the screen. I was frightened and considered deleting the sender, but have not deleted it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you retained the original message and have not deleted it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見せてください。相手から、直接会うように言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me. Did they tell you to meet in person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会う話はありません。電話するよう番号が書かれていますが、そこへかけて説明するのはやめて、こちらに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 面会要請はなく記載番号へも電話していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was no mention of meeting. A number was given for me to call, but instead of calling to explain, I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that there was no request to meet and you did not call the listed number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。リンクを開いたこと、入力していないこと、電話していないことをそれぞれ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will ask separately about opening the link, not entering information, and not calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三つをお伝えします。もう一度リンクを開かず、今残っているメッセージを見ながら相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存の記録でリンク開封と未入力未通話を分けて相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain those three points. Without reopening the link, I want to consult using the message still saved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult from existing records, separating opening the link from not entering information and not calling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、保存されているメッセージを拝見します。入力などがなかったか、順にお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let me see the saved message. We will ask in order whether you entered anything and what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱をお送りになるのですね。中には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending this box. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本と衣類です。家族へ送るんですが、持ち上げてみるとかなり重くて、このままでいいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本と衣類の箱が重く受取家族の運搬を考えて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Books and clothes. I am sending them to my family, but lifting it feels very heavy, so I want to ask whether this is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the heavy box of books and clothes with consideration for the receiving family's carrying it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず重さを確認しますね。受け取る方は、ご自身で箱を運ばれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first check its weight. Will the recipient carry the box themselves?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母が一人で受け取ります。本だけを詰めた小さい箱も重かったので、箱が小さければ楽とは限らないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母一人が受取り小箱でも本だけだと重いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My mother will receive it alone. Even a small box filled only with books was heavy, so small does not necessarily mean easy to carry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother receives it alone and a small box of only books is still heavy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分ける場合は、中身の配分も考えていただくとよいでしょう。二箱にする料金も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If dividing it, consider the distribution of contents too. We can also check the cost of two boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料金の違いは知りたいです。ただ、母が運べるようにしたいので、本を二つに分け、隙間に衣類を入れる形を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金差を聞きつつ本を分散し衣類と組み合わせる案を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know the price difference. But I want my mother to be able to carry them, so I am considering splitting the books in two and filling the gaps with clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the price difference and suggest distributing books and combining them with clothes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱を増やす場合は、それぞれ測ってからのご案内になります。今日は中身を分け直す場所は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If adding boxes, we can advise after measuring each. Do you need somewhere to redistribute the contents today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で詰め直します。ここで慌てて本を全部出すより、母に受け取りの都合も電話で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅で梱包し直し母の受取都合を先に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will repack at home. Rather than hurriedly taking all the books out here, I also want to call my mother about a convenient time to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain repacking at home and first asking your mother about convenient receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、今回は差し出さずに、二箱の準備をしてからお持ちください。料金の見方はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please do not send it this time; bring the two prepared boxes later. Here is how to read the prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰ります。母の都合を聞いて、重さが片方に偏らないよう分けてから、二箱分の料金を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日発送を見送り配分と母の都合を確認して二箱の送料相談へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home today. After asking my mother's availability and distributing the weight so it is not concentrated in one box, I will ask about postage for two boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide against sending today and return for two-box postage advice after checking distribution and your mother's availability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。この箱の重さをメモでお渡しします。詰め直す際の参考にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will give you a note of this box's weight. Please use it as a reference when repacking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みのご相談ですね。ご案内をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a transfer. Do you have the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込むつもりです。ただ、通帳を見たら昨日同じ金額が引かれていて、先にそれが何か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の手動振込前に同額の口座引落しを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intend to transfer my rent. But I saw the same amount deducted yesterday in my passbook and want to check what that was first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request to check an account debit of the same amount before manually transferring rent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この記録ですね。金額が同じでも、ここで家賃の支払いと断定はできません。自動引落しのお申込みはされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This entry, right? The same amount alone does not let us conclude here that it was rent. Did you apply for automatic debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月、管理会社で書類を書きました。いつから引かれるかを覚えていないので、今月も振り込むつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前月の引落申込みと開始時期不明のため手動払いを予定したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last month I filled out forms at the management company. I do not remember when deductions start, so I was planning to transfer this month too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain last month's debit application and planning manual payment because the start date is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理会社へ、今月分を引落しで受け取っているかお尋ねになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you ask the management company whether they received this month's rent by debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話できます。振込はまだ始めず、引落しの開始月と今月の入金を管理会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込を始めず管理会社に開始月と今月の受領を聞くと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can call. I will not begin the transfer yet, and will ask the company the starting month and whether they received this month's payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to ask the management company about the starting month and this month's receipt before beginning a transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。通帳のこの日付と金額を伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check. You can give them this date and amount from the passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞けました。管理会社は今月から引落しで、今月分も受け取ったと言っています。私の振込は不要とのことでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理会社が今月からの引落しと受領を確認したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked. The management company says deductions start this month and they received this month's rent. They said I need not make a transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the management company confirmed deductions start this month and receipt of payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、本日の振込依頼は取りやめでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then shall we cancel today's transfer request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、取りやめます。管理会社の回答を日付と一緒にメモして、来月も自動引落しの案内を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手動振込を取りやめ回答を記録して今後の案内を見直すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, cancel it. I will note the company's answer with the date and review the automatic-debit instructions again next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to cancel the manual transfer, record the answer and review future instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。振込は行っていません。通帳をお返ししますので、どうぞお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. No transfer has been made. Here is your passbook; please take it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この買物袋もお買い上げですね。ご一緒に登録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are buying this shopping bag too. I will ring it up together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、その袋は家から持ってきた私のものです。前にこの店で買ったので、タグが付いたままなんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計中の袋は新規購入品でなく持参の私物と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me, that bag is mine, brought from home. I bought it at this store before, so its tag is still attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct that the bag being rung up is your own brought item, not a new purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 失礼しました。いま袋の代金を登録したので、取り消しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am sorry. I just added the bag charge, so I will cancel it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。中に名前も書いてあるので、確認してください。次からは、このタグを外して持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私物の目印とタグが残った理由を伝え袋代取消を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. My name is also written inside, so please check. Next time I will remove this tag before bringing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the mark identifying your property and why the tag remains, and request cancellation of the bag charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り消しました。画面の合計が変わっていますので、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is canceled. Please check the changed total on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、袋の分がなくなりました。今日はこの袋に買った物を入れるので、新しい袋も不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取消後の合計を確認し新規袋も不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the bag charge is gone. I will put today's purchases in this bag, so I do not need a new bag either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the revised total and say no new bag is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お支払いはカードでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Will you pay by card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、このカードです。食品と日用品を分けたいので、洗剤は袋に入れず、このまま持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード払いを選び洗剤を食品と分けて袋外で持つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this card. I want to separate food from daily necessities, so I want to carry the detergent as it is, outside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose card payment and request to carry detergent outside the bag, apart from food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 洗剤は別にお渡しします。お支払いが済みました。こちらがお控えとレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will hand the detergent separately. Payment is complete. Here are your payment slip and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートにも袋の代金がないと確認できました。食品を持参袋へ入れ、洗剤は別に持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートの袋代取消を確認し食品と洗剤を分けて持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked that the receipt has no bag charge either. I will put food in my brought bag and carry the detergent separately home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check cancellation of the bag charge on the receipt and decide to carry food and detergent separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。持参の袋と洗剤、お控えをお忘れなくお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please remember your own bag, detergent and payment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 少しお待ちください。清掃の車がこの園路を通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait a moment. A cleaning vehicle will pass along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩で奥へ行くところでした。道の脇へ寄れば通れますか。それとも、ここで待ったほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業車のため道脇を通れるか待つべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going farther in for a walk. Can I pass along the side, or should I wait here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to pass at the side or wait because of a work vehicle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この区間は狭いので、車が通り終わるまで待っていただけますか。こちらの広い所へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This stretch is narrow. Could you wait until it has passed? Please move to this wider area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ移ります。友人が少し先を歩いているので、私だけ遅れると気付かないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待機場所へ移り先行する友人が待機に気付かない可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move here. My friend is walking a little ahead and might not notice if only I fall behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move to the waiting place and explain that your friend ahead may not notice the wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お連れの方にも止まっていただくよう、こちらから声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will call to your companion and ask them to stop too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私も名前を呼びます。車の前を横切って追い付くのはやめて、ここで一緒に待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人を呼び車前を横切らず合流して待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will call their name too. Instead of crossing in front of the vehicle to catch up, we will wait together here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will call your friend and wait together without crossing in front of the vehicle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れの方もこちらへ戻られましたね。作業が終わったらお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your companion is back here too. We will tell you when the work is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。車が見えなくなっただけで歩き始めず、係員の方から声を掛けてもらうまで待てばいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再開は車が消えた時ではなく係員の声掛け後と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. We should not start walking merely because the vehicle disappears from view, but wait for a staff member to tell us, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that walking resumes after staff guidance, not when the vehicle disappears. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。後ろから別の作業車も来ますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Another work vehicle is coming from behind, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人ともここで待ちます。作業が終わって通れると案内されたら、散歩を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で待機し通行案内後に散歩を続けると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will both wait here. When told the work is finished and we may pass, we will continue our walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait together and continue walking after passage guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。通れるようになりましたら、私からお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. I will let you know when you can pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行案内のことでしょうか。お急ぎですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about service information? Are you in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十時から会社で会議があります。この列車が遅れているので、別の経路なら間に合うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会議時刻を示し遅れた列車の代わりに間に合う経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a company meeting from ten. This train is delayed, so I want to know if another route could get me there in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the meeting time and ask about an alternative to the delayed train that arrives in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別経路でも、この案内では到着まで四十分ほどかかります。十時まで何分ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even the alternative route takes about forty minutes according to this guide. How long is it until ten?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十分しかありません。経路を変えても間に合わないので、会議の担当者に先に電話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代替でも遅れると分かり会社へ先に電話したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only twenty minutes. Even changing routes will not get me there in time, so I want to call the meeting organizer first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain realizing the alternative will also be late and wanting to call the company first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通話でしたら、改札横の広い所をご利用ください。列車の再開時刻はまだご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For a call, use the wide area beside the ticket gates. We cannot yet announce when trains will resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで会社に聞きます。会議だけスマホで参加し、その後に向かえるか相談してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会議の遠隔参加と後からの移動を会社へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my company from there. I will discuss joining just the meeting by smartphone and heading there afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain asking the company about joining the meeting remotely and traveling afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お電話はできましたか。移動のご予定は変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Were you able to call? Have your travel plans changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、最初の説明はオンラインで参加できることになりました。通話中は移動せず、終わったら別経路で会社へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: オンライン参加の承認を報告し通話終了後に移動すると変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I can join the initial explanation online. I will not move during the call and will go to the company by another route when it ends.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report approval for online participation and change to traveling after the call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでしたら、出発する時点の案内をまたご確認ください。今の経路情報も変わる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then check the information again when you depart. The route information available now may also change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞き終わってから、最新の経路を見て移動します。無理に十時の到着を目指すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会議後に最新経路を確認し元の到着目標を追わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the explanation, I will check the latest route and travel. I will stop trying to force an arrival by ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the latest route after the meeting and abandon the original arrival target. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通話は広い所でお願いします。ご出発の際は、また窓口へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please make your call in the wide area. Speak to us at the counter again when you leave.
